source.title: Optogenetic stimulation of a cortical biohybrid implant guides goal directed behavior

material: SU-8 microwell scaffold on fused silica bonded to glass coverslip, loaded with primary cortical neurons

formulation.evidence: microwell scaffolds were loaded with 0.1 mg/mL poly-d-Lysine (Gibco) and 0.1 mg/mL Laminin (Millipore Sigma, L2020) in DI water for at least one hour
microwell scaffolds were loaded with 0.1 mg/mL poly-d-Lysine (Gibco) and 0.1 mg/mL Laminin (Millipore Sigma, L2020) in DI water for at least one hour

processing.evidence: exposed to O2 plasma in a Technics RIE for 2 minutes at 50W and 300mTorr
SU-8 2010 photoresist (Kayaku) was spun at 3000 rpm for 30 seconds
soft-baked at 95℃ for 3.5 minutes on a hotplate
We completed a post exposure bake of 4 minutes at 95 ℃
a UV flood-exposure was used with a total UV energy of ~1.86 J
the wafers were hard baked by holding at 95℃ for 5 minutes and then ramping to 200℃ for 2 minutes on a hotplate
cured in an oven at 65℃ for 2 hours
centrifuged at 300 RCF for 5 minutes at room temperature

description.value: no visible structural deterioration of microwell scaffold
description.evidence: structural deterioration of the microwell scaffold even months after implantation

biology.cell_type: embryonic primary cortical neurons (E14.5-E15.5) transduced with AAV CheRiff-eGFP / jRGECO1a

other_outcomes.evidence: Five of nine mice in this cohort passed criterion performance in the three weeks training period
other_outcomes.name: mice reaching criterion performance in optical stimulation task

other_outcomes.evidence: best session performance for biohybrid rate averaged 0.25±0.24 bits per second mean±s.d., n = 9
other_outcomes.name: best session bit rate

survival.evidence: These experiments determined that on average we filled 77±15% (mean ± s.d., n=23 microwell scaffolds, Figure 1d-f).
At this time point, we found 52±23% (mean±s.d.) of microwells to be loaded with neurons expressing fluorescent protein (n=13 implants

notes: SU-8 microwells: 10 µm diameter, 15 µm deep, 15 µm pitch hexagonal lattice; 5x5 mm die on 7 mm coverslip; implanted cell-side down on cortical surface after craniectomy and duratomy over S1.
